question: Per board of connection-parity, in routing pass 1 without the optimizer, how many connections does the krt-grid connection router route compared with the Freerouting maze search (freerouting-connection), at what median wall time per connection, and does every connection krt-grid reports as routed have no clearance violation and no via in a pad? A report, not a keep/reject decision: X06 measures the full pipeline.

maze.engine: freerouting-rs at the commit that lands X05, freerouting-krt's in-process harness (the CLI does not call freerouting_krt::register yet)

eligibility: every board of the set; a board where neither arm attempts a connection counts as neutral, printed
grading: Rust's DRC on each routed connection's new items (clearance_violations) and the stage's via-in-pad test (any pin pad), inside the probe; no KiCad grading (the fixtures have no .kicad_pcb)

metric_definitions.routed: connections whose outcome is Routed in pass 1
metric_definitions.attempted: connections whose outcome is Routed, Failed or InsertError in pass 1
metric_definitions.drc_new: summed over the arm's routed connections: clearance violations of the items with an id at or above the outcome's first_new_id, right after the connection
metric_definitions.via_in_pad: summed over the arm's routed connections: new vias whose copper overlaps a pin's pad
metric_definitions.median_ms_per_connection: median wall time of ConnectionRouter::route over the board's connections (report only, D2: never decides anything)

decision_table.pass: report only: krt-grid stays off by default; X06 decides on the bundle
decision_table.fail: report only: the numbers go in X05.6's done note; X06 decides

timing: the registered run waits for P04's default-tree decision (P00 README 'Order', Q00 README 'Order and critical path'); the X05 done note gives a pre-P04 run at the landing commit, not this registration's result
